analyst_view.overall: Early view: Marseille play Levski Sofia in the Europa League on the Thursday, so this Sunday lunchtime trip comes on short rest. Auxerre (14th) have the worst overall defence in the league but have been far harder to beat at home, where Will Still's side had conceded only six goals before the break.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. I lean lower: Auxerre's home defending has been solid, and Marseille's legs will be tested three days after Levski. Marseille's attack (2.2 goals a game) still makes a goal or two likely, but a high-scoring game is less likely at the Abbe-Deschamps.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners. That looks fair: Auxerre average 4.7 and Marseille 4.5 a game. Auxerre won only one corner in their last home game, against Paris FC, which is the risk to the downside.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards. I lean higher: per Statz Auxerre commit the most fouls in Ligue 1 (16.3 a game) and made 24 against Paris FC. Marseille keep the ball (55.7% on average), which should draw plenty of fouls.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.4 shots. Season averages (Auxerre 11.1, Marseille 13.2) match that closely, so I stay put. Marseille's rotation after Levski could take a little off.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.0 shots on target. I lean slightly lower: Auxerre managed only two on target in their home game with Paris FC, and their compact home set-up should limit Marseille's clear looks. Eight looks about right.
